tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Original Equipment Manufacturers OR Suppliers to OEMs OR ASRTU Rate Contract with OE Status OR Manufacturers with a minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 2.50 Crores for preceding 03 years.i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 OR Micro and small scale industries with minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 1.21Crore for preceding last two years i.e 2024-25 & 2025-26)
As per mentioned in the tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per mentioned in the tender documents

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: ASRTU RC firm should submit valid ASRTU RC with OE Status copy for tendered items as proof of their status in case of ASRTU Rate contract with OE Status
Audited Statement of Accounts Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheet for the year 2023-2024 to 2025-26

Certificate of Incorporation/ Certificate of Registration issued by the Registrar of Companies/ Industries and Commerce Dept in proof of manufacturing status along with MOA or Annexures/ enclosures to certificate
Certificate of verification issued by the chartered accountant in the format prescribed
GST return acknowledged by the concerned commercial tax officer for the year 2023-2024 to 2025-26
MSME Certificate/ Udyog Adhar certificate/ SSE Certificate or certificates issued by any Government as a proof of manufacturer of tendered items.
Statement no 01 details of supplies to OEMs
Suppliers to OEMs should submit purchase order copies along with supporting invoice copies placed by OEMs
